name: Money Under the Hood
tagline: How money and tech actually work. One thing a day.
premise: Every short opens on the desk, picks one mechanism (how compound interest works, what an index fund holds, what a GPU does) and shows it with cinematic visual metaphors while a calm voice explains it with sourced numbers. The viewer leaves understanding one thing, never told what to buy.
audience: 18 to 30 year olds with their first real paycheck, and curious people who like knowing how things work. They scroll at lunch and before bed; they distrust finance bros.

anchor.description: a dark wooden desk at night lit by a single warm brass banker's lamp with a green glass shade; on it an open cloth-bound ledger with ruled pages, a vintage hand-crank mechanical calculator, a white ceramic mug of cold coffee, and a small glowing screen casting a faint cool light; a rain-streaked window behind over a dim city; moody, tactile, slightly worn
anchor.never: no people, no hands, no readable text or numbers on the ledger or screen, no stock tickers, no cash piles, no gold bars, no Lamborghinis, no neon, never bright daylight

look.palette: near-black backgrounds, warm brass and amber from the lamp, cool teal from the screen, deep green, worn wood and paper
look.lighting: single warm key light, soft cool fill, lots of shadow, subtle haze; metaphor scenes keep the same amber-and-teal split
look.lens: 50mm, shallow depth of field, slow deliberate moves: push-ins, slides, one orbit; nothing handheld
look.setting: the desk, plus one visual-metaphor location per short (a vault, a greenhouse, a train yard, a server hall, a market at dawn) rendered in the same palette
look.text_style: clean white mono-spaced numerals and short labels, centred, with a thin amber underline; one line at a time

formats.name: How It Actually Works
structure: Hook (5s): the desk; on-screen question 'How does X actually work?'
Mechanism (8s + 8s + 7s): three visual metaphors, one step each, voiceover carries the facts
Land it (7s): back to the desk, the one-line takeaway, source on screen

formats.name: The Number
structure: Hook (5s): one big number on screen over the desk
What it means (8s + 8s): two scenes that make the number physical
Where it's from (7s): the desk, source on screen

formats.name: Build Log
structure: Hook (5s): the screen on the desk glows; 'Today I built X' on screen
What happened (8s + 8s + 8s): the problem, the thing that broke, the fix
Lesson (8s): the desk, one honest line
